answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so past endorsements lose influence unless an identity continues providing verifiable, honest service. EigenTrust-style centrality is earned through trusted paths and reciprocity-weighted endorsements; a fresh Sybil identity has negligible incoming trust and near-zero eigenvector centrality, leaving it unable to meet consensus thresholds. Like a sonnet carried across an ocean, credibility takes sustained effort—not a velvet disguise—to build.
